info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Methods-v2-spec
info.description: The List Payment Methods API allows businesses to retrieve available payment options offered to customers. This endpoint supports the integration of various payment methods into applications and websites, enhancing customer payment experiences. Typically consumed by e-commerce platforms and payment integration services, this API provides essential data for dynamic payment method selection. It empowers developers to streamline checkout processes by offering users their preferred payment methods in real-time.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of all available payment methods that can be used for transactions. It provides the necessary information to facilitate the selection of payment options for users.

requestBody.description: Request body to fetch available payment methods. This operation allows the user to retrieve all currently supported payment methods for transactions.

204.description: Request completed successfully without any content.

ListPaymentsPaymentsMethodsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on payment methods. It is expected to be a string value.

ListPaymentsPaymentsMethodsResponse_204.title: Payment Method Response

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the payment processing.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the payment transaction.

resultId.description: The result identifier for tracking the payment processing outcome.

state.description: The current state of the payment processing.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the payment in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the payment processing.

ListPaymentsPaymentsMethodsResponse_204.description: Response schema for the payment method operations indicating the result of the payment processing request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier or name of the user or system that created the payment entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the payment entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the payment operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details related to the audit information of the payment operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
